title: Kissinger directs the CFR study group on nuclear weapons

tellings.quote: In 1955, Kissinger was invited to direct a Council on Foreign Relations study group on nuclear war and foreign policy.

plain: In 1955 the future statesman Henry Kissinger was invited to lead a study group on nuclear war and foreign policy at the Council on Foreign Relations, a private New York foreign policy club, work that led to his book Nuclear Weapons and Foreign Policy. Michels tells this himself, naming the physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer and the atomic energy official Gordon Dean in connection with it, in an episode asking whether Kissinger also oversaw a program to recover crashed UFOs.
